recipe.title: Beef shin ragu
recipe.notes: This is a Chelsea Winter recipe.
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 140 deg C (120 deg C fan), or use a slow cooker.

i.n: beef shin, beef cheeks, chuck steak or gravy beef

method.s: Pat beef dry with paper towels. Season with salt and pepper all over.
Sear beef in oil over very high heat to brown (in batches, if needed). Set aside.
Cook onion, garlic, celery, carrot and herbs over medium heat, for about 10 minutes, until soft.
Add beef, vegetables, tomato paste, anchovies, wine, stock and bay leaves to a slow cooker or casserole dish.
Cook for 3.5 to 4 hours (on high, if using slow cooker). The beef should pull apart easily. Shred it with two forks.
Transfer sauce to a saucepan and boil on stove-top to thicken, or use cornflour.
Serve with pasta or mash, grated Parmesan and chopped parsley.
